sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Ab]In times like these you need a [Bbm]Savior,

[Ab]Be very [Db]sure, [Ab/C]be [Db]very [Ab/Eb]sure
[Ab/Eb]Your anchor holds [Eb7]and grips [Ab]the solidRock!
[Eb7]This Rock is Jesus, [Ab]Yes, He’s the One;

[Db]Be [Ab/C]very [Db]sure, [Ab/Eb]be very sure
[Eb7]Your anchor holds and [Ab]grips the solidRock!
